title: Northbeam TechWorks Attendance: Failed Visits, Notice and Calling Work Off
content:
A failed attendance on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job is recorded only after the crew has waited at the address for the service's grace minutes, or after the bench slot has passed with the item not brought in.

## When a fee of this kind may be billed at all

A failed-attendance fee, a fee for calling the work off, a slot-move fee or a crew attendance charge is billed only while the agreement stands booked, dispatched, recorded as a failed attendance, or called off. The state is read from the work order, against the agreement the fee names, before the fee is booked.

## The failed-attendance fee

The service's failed-attendance fee is billed once per failed attendance, and a second failed attendance on the same job is billed again. The fee is waived where the customer gave notice before the crew set out.

## Calling the work off

Work called off with at least the service's notice hours is billed nothing; called off with less, the service's fee for calling the work off is billed.

A job called off because the retailer cannot carry it out, because the part is unobtainable, or because the item turns out to be beyond economic repair is billed nothing, and any deposit taken is returned.

## A profile with repeated failed attendances

Where the profile has three or more failed attendances in the rolling year — counted as the jobs of the profile that reached a failed attendance over the rolling twelve calendar months ending on the handling date — further visits are booked only with the fee taken in advance.

## What a failed attendance does not do

A failed attendance does not draw an included visit from the pool, and it does not end the job: the customer is offered a fresh slot.

## Questions this standard answers

**A crew arrives, waits the service's grace minutes at an empty address, and leaves.** A failed attendance is properly recorded, and the service's failed-attendance fee is billed.

**A crew arrives, waits less than the grace minutes, and leaves.** The grace minutes have not been waited out, so no failed attendance is recorded on that basis.

**The customer telephones before the crew sets out to say nobody will be home.** The fee is waived, and the notice having come before the crew set out is what waives it.

**One job, two empty attendances.** The fee is billed once for each, the second attendance being billed again rather than absorbed into the first.

The per-service figures this standard reads — the failed-attendance fee, the minutes the crew waits, the notice hours for calling the work off, the fee for calling it off late, the crew attendance charge, the haul-away charge and whether taking the old item away is included — are carried in the fee, attendance and haul-away schedules for the six TechWorks services.
